name: live_case_without_else_is_null
description: A CASE expression with no ELSE branch falls through to NULL when no WHEN matches, so its result is nullable even when every branch returns a NOT NULL column
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
query_sql:
-- @name GetNamesOfUsersWithEmail
-- @returns :many
SELECT u.id, CASE WHEN u.email IS NOT NULL THEN u.name END AS conditional_name FROM users u ORDER BY u.id

columns.name: conditional_name
columns.note: the only branch returns NOT NULL name, but an unmatched CASE with no ELSE yields NULL

sqlc_comparison.sqlc_behavior: sqlc infers the CASE result from its branch types and misses the implicit NULL of the absent ELSE
sqlc_comparison.scythe_improvement: scythe treats a CASE without ELSE as nullable, and the second seeded user has no email so the engine returns the NULL

default: INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (1, 'Ada Lovelace', 'ada@example.com')
INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (2, 'Grace Hopper')
